outcome: Prove whether Planner v2 can produce a plan that an independent implementer uses to complete one real bounded repository change without hidden context or manual rescue.
why_repeatable: Each Planner v2 behavioral scenario uses the same plan, independent implementation, real verification, correction, and clean rerun loop.

steps.result: Identify bounded unresolved behaviors from the real repository rather than inventing a synthetic task.
steps.note: Exclude generated, dependency, secret, and unrelated dirty surfaces from candidate selection.

steps.result: Record the pre-scenario working-tree boundary so existing work is preserved.
steps.note: The scenario may not revert or absorb unrelated changes.

steps.result: Produce and retain one Planner v2 plan from the frozen real request and visible repository evidence.
steps.note: Do not manually rescue or supplement the planner output before implementation.

steps.result: An independent implementer changes only the approved scenario surface using the plan and repository evidence.
steps.note: Clarification requests and hidden-context dependencies are scenario failures and must be recorded.

steps.result: The repository-native focused behavior test passes on the implementation produced from the plan.
steps.note: Observed planner failures become targeted behavioral corrections, not abstract score adjustments.

steps.result: Independent review confirms the implementation satisfies every frozen acceptance criterion without out-of-scope work.
steps.note: Rerun the same scenario cleanly after any Planner v2 correction before declaring it closed.

inputs: The checked-out memory-knowledge repository and its current Planner v2 candidate.
The checked-out agentic-trading repository as the real scenario target.
One frozen bounded task selected from repository evidence before Planner v2 runs.
failure_handling: Stop at the first practical failure, catalog the observed symptom and evidence, correct the Planner v2 boundary that caused it, then rerun the same scenario from a clean isolated implementation state.
verified_path: Scenario passes only when an independent implementer can build the requested behavior from the Planner v2 plan and the real repository verification plus independent review both pass.
